summary: Enterprise LLM applications can be exposed to malicious prompts, prompt injection attempts, instruction overrides, and data extraction requests.
The system must detect whether a user prompt is benign or malicious before it reaches the enterprise LLM application.
A supervised binary text classification pipeline was implemented using TF-IDF features and multiple candidate models.
Logistic Regression was selected because it produced the lowest validation false negatives and the highest malicious recall.
The final model achieved 0.9873 malicious recall and 0.9462 malicious F1-score on the untouched test set.
The implementation demonstrates the Pipe-and-Filter Pattern and Model Registry / Model Versioning Pattern.
